items.title: Charles Calello interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 21, 2025
items.q: I found the original arrangement to “All By Myself” that I did with Eric Carmen.

ctx.x: Did you write your scores in concert pitch or did you transpose the transposing instruments in the score?

I wrote them transposed. In fact before you called I was doing, I found the original arrangement to “All By Myself” that I did with Eric Carmen. Eric died about a year ago and they’re doing a tribute to him with the symphony. And it was originally a seven minute record and I couldn’t find the long version of it so I have the hand written arrangement that we used to the record, so I’m transcribing it into Finale and then I’m going to fill in the parts that are missing. There’s about three minutes of the…

Yeah. When we were corresponding through e-mail to set up this session you said, you wrote, “I’ve just finished a project and delivered the music on Sunday.” So my curiosity is how has delivering the project, the music, changed from the ‘60s until now for you?
